baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional-temporal construction "if you follow me ... do not ask me ... until I initiate" and the roots ت ب ع, س ء ل, ح د ث, and ذ ك ر.
baseline_models.mechanism: Following establishes an ordered relation in which the follower remains behind the guide's unfolding action. Requests are suspended, not abolished: the guide owns the transition from unarticulated occurrence to newly initiated verbal mention.

activation_trace.role: Trailing and following supply the ordered learner-guide relation and make continued accompaniment the frame for the rule.
Questioning as request supplies the learner-initiated act that is temporarily withheld.
Renewed speech as report supplies the guide-initiated disclosure that opens the permitted explanatory phase.
Mention carried on the tongue supplies the eventual articulated account rather than permanent silence.

changed_reading.before: A flat command not to ask questions.
changed_reading.after: A sequencing covenant: remain in the guide's wake, suspend requests during the occurrence, and let the guide initiate its articulation at the set boundary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The linkage "about a thing ... until I produce for you from it a mention" in شَىْءٍ ... مِنْهُ ذِكْرًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The construction separates a reportable object from the account drawn from it. The thing can be present before its intelligible verbal rendering exists, so observation and explanation occupy different phases.

activation_trace.role: The knowable, reportable thing supplies the opaque object about which premature inquiry would be made.
Bringing something into being after it was absent supplies the emergence of an account not yet available at first sight.
A reminder that makes something present again supplies the later interpretive re-presentation of the observed thing.

changed_reading.before: Wait until the guide happens to comment on the thing.
changed_reading.after: Do not force an account from the raw object; the guide will make its intelligible re-presentation arise from it after observation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding loss of mention and subsequent retracing turn delayed ذِكْر into disciplined recovery: meaning is recovered by following signs in sequence, not by a question detached from the event's track.

activation_trace.role: Loss of remembrance supplies the failure mode against which the guide's controlled production of mention is read.
Recollection after forgetting supplies an earlier unstable mention that contrasts with the promised deliberate mention.
A surviving mark that indicates what occurred supplies the evidential track from event to account.
Following a trace supplies the stepwise recovery pattern that sharpens what following in 18:70 demands.

structural_cues: 18:63 places failed mention before 18:64's return along traces; 18:70 reverses the instability by assigning initiation of the next mention to the guide.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forgetting, mention, surviving traces, and retracing; I infer that delayed explanation is a controlled recovery practice. A live alternative is that these verses only establish the meeting's route and do not govern the later speech rule.

changed_reading.before: Following means merely staying physically with the guide until he speaks.
changed_reading.after: Following also means preserving the event's sequence and traces until a deliberate account can recover what first perception or memory failed to hold.

context_deltas.mechanism: The requested following is explicitly for teaching, while the follower lacks encompassing knowledge of the matter's interior. Patience is therefore the operational bridge between partial sight and later disclosure: it restrains intervention while knowledge remains structurally asymmetric.

activation_trace.role: Following supplies the learner's requested mode of access and links the condition in 18:70 to apprenticeship.
Knowledge becoming disclosed to a knower supplies the stated purpose of following and the asymmetry between teacher and learner.
Holding the self back from distress supplies the active discipline performed by not questioning.
Complete cognitive enclosure supplies precisely what the learner lacks, explaining why immediate judgment outruns his position.
Knowledge of a matter's interior supplies the missing depth that the later mention must provide.

structural_cues: 18:66 requests following for instruction; 18:67-68 immediately define the obstacle as patience under non-encompassing knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a teaching request, deficient enclosure, interior knowledge, and patience; I infer that non-questioning protects an observation phase under asymmetric knowledge. The alternative is a narrower obedience test with no epistemic method implied.

changed_reading.after: The guide imposes temporary epistemic restraint: remain observant while lacking the whole interior account, then receive disclosure rather than closing judgment early.

context_deltas.mechanism: The indefinite "anything" is instantiated by acts perceived as rupture and killing, then classified as grave or unrecognizable things. The rule is tested exactly where the visible act exerts maximum moral pressure toward an immediate causal verdict.

activation_trace.role: Questioning as request supplies the prohibited move whose urgency the subsequent acts intensify.
The reportable thing supplies the first concrete filling of 18:70's indefinite object.
Rupture and piercing supply the first alarming surface act that invites premature explanation.
Taking life supplies the second and sharper surface act that makes restraint morally costly.
A severe, strange matter supplies the follower's immediate classification, which the delayed account will later reopen.

structural_cues: The same ش ي ء construction recurs in 18:71 and 18:74 as the follower names each unexplained act before its explanation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rupture, killing, and severe classification; I infer that the delay targets premature causal closure under moral pressure, not moral indifference. A live alternative is that the command tests obedience regardless of what the acts signify.

changed_reading.before: The ban concerns casual or distracting questions.
changed_reading.after: The ban governs the hardest interval: visible harm may rightly provoke alarm, yet its causal and temporal meaning must remain open until the promised account.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated questioning exhausts companionship; at the separation boundary the guide initiates a report of the acts' outcome-oriented interpretation. This realizes the temporal architecture of 18:70: accompaniment contains the unexplained sequence, and initiated report follows its closure.

activation_trace.role: Questioning supplies the acknowledged breach whose repetition is tied to ending the learning relation.
Companionship and continued association supply the social container maintained by the rule.
Separation supplies the boundary at which observation closes and explanatory speech begins.
A delivered report supplies the explicit later speech corresponding to the promised initiated mention.
Return to outcome and consequence supplies the temporal depth of the delayed explanation.

structural_cues: 18:76 makes another question terminate companionship; 18:78 places separation immediately before the announced report of interpretation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a question-conditioned end of companionship followed by report and outcome-reading; I infer that 18:78 fulfills 18:70's until-clause. The live alternative is that 18:78 is a final courtesy rather than the clause's designed completion.

changed_reading.before: The guide may explain each event whenever convenient.
changed_reading.after: Disclosure is boundary-governed: the unexplained sequence is held within companionship, and its outcome-account is initiated when that sequence and relation close.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final account redescribes each visible act through an absent future or hidden relation: damage blocks coercive seizure, loss opens replacement, and repair preserves buried value until extraction. The promised mention is thus a causal reclassification of the thing, not a label appended to it.

activation_trace.role: Bringing a thing into view supplies the guide's later act of making hidden causal structure manifest.
Coercive seizure supplies the unrealized threat that turns apparent damage into preservation.
One thing standing in place of another supplies the future replacement that changes the apparent finality of loss.
Stored, preserved value supplies the hidden beneficiary and delayed purpose of repairing the wall.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the future event for which present concealment is maintained.

structural_cues: The three retrospective explanations in 18:79-82 align each witnessed act with a previously unavailable threat, replacement, or beneficiary.
18:82 closes by denying autonomous authorship and repeating the interpretation/patience formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seizure avoided, replacement intended, and treasure preserved for later extraction; I infer counterfactual causal arrows that reclassify the acts. A live alternative is that each explanation remains case-specific and does not define a general form of ذِكْر.

changed_reading.before: The guide will eventually describe what happened.
changed_reading.after: The guide will generate from each witnessed thing a future-aware causal account that can reverse its first moral and practical classification.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the secondary س ل ل mapping behind س ء ل rather than treating it as the lexical sense of the surface verb. It remains anchored in the focus verb, the phrase مِنْهُ, and the later hidden-treasure/extraction sequence; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for timing and agency, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split mapping of تَسْـَٔلْ to س ل ل, together with "from it" and the guide's exclusive initiation of mention.

activation_trace.role: Gentle, hidden drawing-out supplies an exploratory image of a question as premature extraction from an opaque event.
Making something manifest supplies the authorized counter-movement in which the guide exposes rather than the follower extracts.
Preserved treasure supplies the context's concrete image of value kept hidden until the proper time.
Extraction from concealment supplies the delayed release that makes timing, not mere possession of a question, decisive.

changed_reading.before: Questioning simply requests information that the guide refuses to give yet.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, premature questioning tries to draw hidden significance out before its term, whereas authorized mention lets the guide expose preserved meaning when its sequence has matured.

strongest_changes: The prohibition becomes temporary epistemic restraint within a teaching relation, not a ban on inquiry.
The later report of outcome-oriented interpretation fulfills the focus ayah's separation of witnessed thing from initiated mention.
The final explanations turn mention into counterfactual causal redescription capable of reversing first classifications.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah operates as a protocol for holding morally alarming appearances open until event, consequence, and hidden relation can be articulated together.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 18:78 is a strict fulfillment of the until-clause or only a narratively adjacent final explanation.
How far the trace-recovery pattern of 18:63-64 should govern the later teacher-learner exchange.
The extraction reading depends on a secondary mapped root and must remain analogical and exploratory.
